dedupe_keys.name: bahrain census 2020 building counts by building type ownership and current use per governorate iga data gov bh

description: These three small tables on Bahrain's open data portal, from the Information and eGovernment Authority, give the number of buildings counted in the 2020 census in each of the four governorates (Capital, Muharraq, Northern and Southern). One table splits buildings by type: villa, apartment building, conventional house, traditional house, shop or store, establishment building and others; villas are the largest group, with over 53,000 in the Northern governorate. The second splits buildings by ownership (individual, shared, private, public and others) and the third by current use, residential or non-residential; labels are in English and Arabic. Coverage: the whole Kingdom of Bahrain at governorate level. Access: each table can be viewed, exported and queried through the Opendatasoft explore API; the entries were last modified on 6 June 2023. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): Bahrain Government Open Data License. Access is free of charge. Caveats: counts only, with no building-level or block-level detail; the tables carry spreadsheet residue such as rows with #REF! values and a header row loaded as data, which need cleaning before use. Simulation uses are a census benchmark of the building stock by type and use for calibrating exposure models of Bahrain. Related records: the Qatar building permits and completion certificates statistics.
